summary: The page displays layout mirroring defects in the radio group controls and insufficient text contrast within message blocks under dark RTL mode.

issues.title: RTL indicator misplacement
issues.description: Radio selection indicators remain anchored to the far left while option text is aligned to the right.
issues.evidence: Radio controls appear on the left edge opposite the right-aligned option text.
issues.suggestion: Mirror indicator placement to precede the text on the right side in RTL layout.

issues.title: Low contrast prompt text
issues.description: Prompt text inside the message container lacks sufficient contrast against the dark surface.
issues.evidence: Hebrew text in the upper container renders in dark gray on a dark background.
issues.suggestion: Elevate text brightness tokens to comply with dark mode contrast standards.
